visual_elements.description: Feedforward neural network with 3 input-side nodes (blue circles with Σ), 3 hidden nodes (green circles with Σ), 3 output-side nodes (orange circles with Σ), and 3 rectangular outputs. Blue arrows labeled w_ji connect layer i to j; blue arrows labeled w_kj connect layer j to k. Net_i, Net_j, Net_k labels sit above respective node columns. Purple circles with '1' represent Node Bias connected to current layer nodes.
Pink rounded rectangle labeled 'Input Sample' with dotted arrow pointing right into the network
Pink rounded rectangle labeled 'Target Label' with dotted arrow pointing left from the network
Vertical red rectangle on right side containing repeated text 'Error Error' and class labels Class 1, Class 2, Class m
Three bottom layer indicator boxes with upward arrows: 'Previous Layer (i)' with arrow i, 'Current Layer (You are here)' with arrow j, 'Next Layer (K)' with arrow k
Yellow circle with black number '2' indicating slide number

imagery: Yellow circle slide number icon top-right
Purple Node Bias circles with '1' at bottom of current layer nodes
Dotted connector lines between Input Sample/Target Label and network
typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large bold red. Subtitle is medium bold red. Node labels (Net_i, O_i, w_ji) use italicized variables with subscripts. Layer labels are small black text in light gray boxes. Error box text is white on red. All-caps not used except 'Layer' in layer labels.

recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#f0f0f0). 2. Add title 'Neural Network Model' in bold red (#cc0000) at top-center. 3. Add subtitle '(Each node consists of Summation + Activation)' in bold red below title. 4. Place yellow circle (#ffff00) with black '2' at top-right corner. 5. Add pink (#ff99cc) rounded rectangle 'Input Sample' at top-left with dotted arrow pointing right. 6. Add pink rounded rectangle 'Target Label' at top-right with dotted arrow pointing left. 7. Draw three columns of circular nodes: left column blue (#0000ff) with Σ, middle column green (#00b050) with Σ, right column orange (#ff9900) with Σ. 8. Label net inputs above columns: Net_i, Net_j, Net_k. 9. Label outputs on connections: O_i, O_j, O_k. 10. Draw blue arrows between layers labeled w_ji (left-to-middle) and w_kj (middle-to-right). 11. Add purple (#7030a0) circles with '1' below middle-layer nodes and label 'Node Bias' at bottom-left. 12. Add three rectangles on far right labeled Output 1, Output 2, Output m. 13. Add vertical red (#cc0000) box on right edge with white text 'Error Error' and rows Class 1, Class 2, Class m. 14. Add three light gray boxes at bottom: 'Previous Layer (i)', 'Current Layer (You are here)', 'Next Layer (K)' with upward arrows labeled i, j, k.
